fixtures_note: Fixtures are built by evals/make_fixtures.sh into a temp dir; no network, no secrets.

evals.name: seeded
evals.prompt: can you review my changes on this branch before I merge? I changed pagination to support a page size and added an export helper.
evals.expected_output: Scope includes the committed store change, the staged api.py change and the untracked export.py on a master-default repo with no upstream. Confirms the 1-based->0-based change breaks callers (api default page=1 and export_all start at 1 skip the first page; existing test fails). Unvalidated size (<=0) reported as a separate risk.
assertions: Report states the base used (master or its merge-base) and why
Scope includes the staged app/api.py and untracked app/export.py
Reports as confirmed that page() indexing change breaks callers / skips the first page, with file:line evidence
Gives a concrete failure scenario (e.g. page=1 returns item-11.., or export misses item-1..10)
Covers both callers (api.py and export.py) or the existing test failure as evidence
Separates confirmed defects from unverified/plausible risks
No numeric confidence scores and no claim the change is guaranteed correct

must: 0-based page() breaks 1-based callers (api default, export_all, existing test)
valid_extra: response echoes requested not applied size
tests/ lacks __init__ so discovery runs 0 tests

evals.name: clean
evals.prompt: review feature/slug against main please, I added a slugify helper
evals.expected_output: Zero confirmed defects; says so plainly; no style/formatting nitpicks presented as defects.
assertions: Does not present formatting/naming/style opinions as defects
No numeric confidence scores and no claim the change is guaranteed correct

valid_extra: tests/ lacks __init__ so discovery runs 0 tests (as unverified/note)

evals.name: ambiguous
evals.prompt: second opinion on this rate limiting change before it goes out? it's for the notification service
evals.expected_output: Per-process in-memory limiter: effectiveness under multiple workers/restarts depends on deployment not in repo -> UNVERIFIED with what would settle it. Unbounded _hits growth may be confirmed minor.
assertions: Flags per-process/in-memory state (multiple workers, restarts) as a risk
Labels the deployment-dependent risk as unverified/plausible rather than a confirmed defect
States what information or check would settle the unverified risk
No numeric confidence scores and no claim the change is guaranteed correct
